correctness.rationale: For n≥3 the rung masks b_i encode every labelled selected vertex set of C_n □ K2, and the 16-state transition enforces that each selected middle-rung vertex has at most one of the previous, next and opposite-layer neighbors; cyclic trace of T^n is therefore exactly the signed face enumerator. Independent symbolic construction gives charpoly x^10(x²−x+1)(x⁴−x²−2x+1); the six nonzero characteristic roots yield the order-six recurrence and initial exact traces 4,−3,11,10,1,29. The quartic derivative 2(x−1)(2x²+2x+1), α>17/40 and β>69/50, plus reciprocal product bound |γ|<1.31 imply a uniform rational lower bound Z_n>0 for all n≥14. The n3..13 direct traces close the finite gap, establishing nonzero signed Euler for every n≥3. Euler–Poincaré lower-bounds rational total Betti by |Z_n|, giving exponential rate β. Independent brute induced-degree enumerations for n=3,4,5,6 agree with traces; all-n logic uses analytic roots, not the finite sample.

value.rationale: The first higher-independence/dissociation complex of the canonical cyclic width-two prism family is a natural missing infinite family. Uniform nonvanishing and a quantitative exponential rational Betti lower bound are substantial topological constraints for future homotopy classifications, not a tiny isolated graph count. The exact recurrence and dominant growth rate are determined by a motivated fixed-width transfer structure.
